concepts.name: marten
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original Kuizer desktop app icon, an exceptional sculptural MASCOT direction called MARTEN. Kuizer cleans developer disk caches. Attached image is only a reference for microscopic 3D rendering craftsmanship and restrained friendly character, do not copy that ghost. Subject: a compact curled-up pine marten, a clever small woodland animal, with a large elegant sweeping tail wrapped protectively around its rounded body into an almost circular silhouette. Three-quarter front view, two small rounded ears, short muzzle, two tiny dark obsidian inset eyes, beautiful uncluttered face. No human body. Material: warm cream porcelain face and chest set into chestnut and burnt-orange satin ceramic body and tail, with precisely machined golden seam details. Looks like a collectible art-toy made by a luxury ceramics studio, sophisticated and memorable rather than a cartoon illustration. Visible porcelain microtexture, delicate edge bevels, soft studio top-left light, warm realistic ambient occlusion and grounded shadows, subtle specular glints, exceptionally clean modeled geometry. Strong readable silhouette even at 32 pixels. The animal IS the icon: no rounded-square tile, no badge, no background panel, no ring around it. Isolated centered full object, fills 78 percent of a 1024x1024 square canvas with 11 percent empty margin. Genuinely transparent background. No text, letters, watermark, props, cleaning tools, ribbon, eraser, or K monogram. One original premium icon only.

concepts.name: cutaway
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Original Kuizer app icon concept CUTAWAY. A developer tool for reclaiming disk space. Make a restrained, highly sophisticated physical symbol, 1024 x 1024 square, isolated on genuine alpha transparency. Subject: a single heavy chamfered graphite titanium cube shown isometrically, with a clean diagonal quarter-section lifted away from the upper-right corner, revealing a rich vermilion-orange anodized interior and a striking exact negative-space gap. One small separated matching chunk hovers a short distance from its original place. Elegant readable bold silhouette, architectural solid geometry, sparse and calm. The cube is precisely milled brushed dark titanium: fine directional machining lines, generous bevels catching a thin silver studio highlight, near-black satin faces. Inside cut faces are matte burnt orange, subtle warm bounce light between the two pieces. Model like a luxury industrial-design studio's miniature object, exquisite PBR rendering with true depth and soft cast shadows. Reference image is only for geometry and the quality of its edges and surface detail, not its logo. Entire object fills 76 percent of frame, centered, substantial transparent margin. No backing tile or rounded-square container, no sparkle, glow, neon, glass, gradients splashed over the object, letters, text, monogram, existing logos, eraser, ribbon, broom, or extra decorative clutter. One icon, not a presentation or sheet.

concepts.name: strata
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One premium ORIGINAL desktop app icon for Kuizer, a developer disk cleaning tool. Concept STRATA: a distinctive sculptural mark of three broad softly chamfered slabs stepping down in length from top to bottom, stacked vertically with precise generous dark negative-space gaps. Their left edges align, their right ends step inward to form an elegant descending silhouette, suggesting progressively less clutter. Make the three slabs warm white porcelain on their upper faces and muted jade-green satin anodized metal on their thick side faces, with exposed thin metallic rim edges. The slabs float slightly above a deep forest-green soft square tile with very subtly rounded corners, NOT a thick candy glass squircle. Tile is matte microtextured powder-coated metal, with a thin beveled champagne rim. Palette: restrained sage, warm ivory, deep olive and champagne. Design-forward sophisticated Swiss modernist desktop software identity, substantial understated miniature 3D object, near frontal slightly elevated view. Meticulous material realism, restrained soft top-left studio lighting, tiny realistic machining detail, soft deep contact shadows, precise microbevels. Attached image is a craftsmanship and geometric depth reference only, do not copy its diagonal striped circular logo. Square 1024x1024 transparent background. Tile centered, fills 80 percent of image, all edges fully inside frame. No text, letters, logos from reference, sparkles, glass, neon, ribbons, erasers, brooms, K, or additional symbols. One finished icon only.

concepts.name: prompt
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original highly crafted Kuizer desktop app icon called PROMPT. Developer disk cleanup utility, a precise trusted little terminal tool. Subject: a single chunky vintage-workstation keycap with rounded rectangular top, sculpted dished face and tall tapered sides, shown near frontal with its top surface and lower side walls visible. Top face is almost-black textured PBT polymer, fine sandblasted texture. Sidewalls brushed gunmetal aluminum, subtle diagonal milled edges, dark graphite. Inset on its top is the terminal prompt symbol >_ made from thick continuous warm chartreuse translucent resin, flush inlaid into engraved tracks. Symbol consists of a bold chevron to the left and short underscore to the lower right, simple, readable, expertly proportioned. Tiny warm edge reflections make resin tangible but NOT an emissive neon sign. A narrow lime accent line along the lower lip. Studio soft-box from upper left, dark shadows beneath beveled ledges, precise surface texture and amazing PBR materials. High-end industrial design object for a developer desktop, understated, not plastic candy. Isolated keycap is the entire icon, NO background tile or extra container. Square 1024x1024 output, genuine transparent background, centered object takes up 78 percent of frame with generous empty margin. Reference images provide craftsmanship and simple symbol detail only; do not copy reference identities. No other text, no wordmark, no letters, no watermark, no glowy background, no extra keyboard keys, no hands, eraser, broom, ribbon, or K. One icon only.
